# Notes across a document

A café and 日本語 have a shared note[^shared]. Another note[^second] follows.

The first note returns here[^SHARED]. A missing note[^missing] stays literal.

| Column | Note |
| --- | --- |
| A table | A reference[^second] |

[^shared]: A **formatted** note with [a link](https://example.com).

    A second paragraph, and a nested list:

    - First item
    - Second item with `inline code`

[^second]: A short note.

[^unused]: An unreferenced definition remains editable.
